baseline: Base 0b328cda7743b6715b7deb95b728de72ab9de529 contains the DEVX-047 task spec. At base, App.tsx mounted CoopBoardScreen and OpenCodeSessionsScreen unconditionally inside RecoverableRenderErrorBoundary blocks (boundaryId overlay.coop-board / overlay.opencode-sessions) for every activeView; both screens returned a bare <Card className='mx-auto mt-8 ...'> with no visibility gate, so they visually appeared stacked in whatever empty space remained below the active screen (observed directly 2026-08-05 on the Automations view). CoopLearningReviewScreen (DEVX-043) already gated correctly on a coop-learning-review:open window event dispatched from a titlebar button — the precedent this task was asked to match if a pane fit did not. Investigation of the pane fit (criterion 1): lib/pane-manager's PaneManager is terminal/PTY-scoped (createInitialPane -> openTerminal, ptyId, terminal.focus(), WebGL/GPU rendering control, TerminalLeafId); tab-group's geometry/split layer is keyed per-worktree (every DOM lookup, captureTabGroupPanelGeometrySnapshot, resolvePanelEdgePaneColumnSplit and layout map uses data-worktree-id / groupsByWorktree / layoutByWorktree). The pane/tab model is inherently scoped to one worktree's workspace and cannot host a repo-root-scoped screen like the Coop Task Board (reads repoRoot via coopBoard:listTasks) or the global OpenCode Sessions registry without inventing a generic-widget pane kind the task explicitly forbids. Settings/SkillsPage-style activeView pages are the app's other non-worktree utility surface, but TopLevelView lives in shared/types.ts and sidebar entries in SidebarNav.tsx — both outside this task's scope.allow. Chosen fit: titlebar-button + window-event-gated docked overlay panels in App.tsx, matching the DEVX-043 precedent while staying fully inside scope.allow (App.tsx + the two component dirs). Result commit 4b4374334421e95ef7265325da64760a4cec0798 (relocate Coop Board and OpenCode Sessions into on-demand docked panels) makes both screens render null until their open event fires, docks them as right-side pointer-events-transparent panels (surrounding UI stays usable), and adds titlebar triggers.
regressions: None observed. Both screens' pre-existing tsc errors (CoopBoardScreen.tsx:8 import depth TS2307 for ../../../main/ipc/coop-board and the getTaskStateLabel switch TS2366) are unchanged from base — verified by diffing base 0b328cda against HEAD: identical lines, not introduced by this task (DEVX-043's artifact documented the same pre-existing base errors). App.tsx and OpenCodeSessionsScreen.tsx typecheck clean. The two pre-existing TS6307 project-structure errors in tsconfig.web.json (main-process files not listed) are config noise unrelated to this change. No product behavior outside the relocated screens was modified.

No source file outside scope.allow was touched.
